descriptionNullable: This dataset provides insights into the spending habits of Gen Z (ages 18-27) across various categories such as rent, groceries, entertainment, education, savings, and more. It contains 1700 records and 15 financial attributes, making it a valuable resource for financial trend analysis, budgeting studies, and machine learning applications in personal finance.
